title: Which Disney princess are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Disney princess quiz: answer 12 questions to find out whether you are Cinderella, Belle, Ariel, Jasmine, Mulan, Rapunzel, Tiana or Moana. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Are you a bookworm, a dreamer, a hard worker or an explorer? Answer 12 questions about your dreams, your friends and how you face a challenge to find your Disney princess.
about: This quiz matches your personality with eight heroines from Disney animated films: Cinderella, Belle (Beauty and the Beast), Ariel (The Little Mermaid), Jasmine (Aladdin), Mulan, Rapunzel (Tangled), Tiana (The Princess and the Frog) and Moana.

Your result names your princess and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney; the names and characters belong to their owners.

faq.a: Cinderella, Belle, Ariel, Jasmine, Mulan, Rapunzel, Tiana and Moana. Your result names your main match and shows your score for all eight.

faq.q: Is one princess rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every princess appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite princess here?
faq.a: Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. Snow White, Aurora, Pocahontas, Merida and others may join in a later update.

cinderella.name: Cinderella
cinderella.body: You are kind, patient and quietly resilient. Hard times haven't made you bitter, and you still believe good things are coming. Your gentle strength wins people over. Ask for what you deserve.

belle.name: Belle
belle.body: You are bookish, curious and unafraid to be different. You look past appearances and see the best in people. Your independent mind is your greatest strength.

ariel.name: Ariel
ariel.body: You are adventurous, passionate and endlessly curious about the world beyond your own. You follow your heart, sometimes faster than your head. Your courage takes you places others only dream of.

jasmine.name: Jasmine
jasmine.body: You are confident, independent and sharp. You won't let anyone decide your life for you, and you speak up for what you believe. You have a big heart under a strong will.

mulan.name: Mulan
mulan.body: You are brave, resourceful and fiercely loyal to your family. You'd take on any challenge to protect the people you love, and you prove doubters wrong. Remember you're worth it as you are.

rapunzel.name: Rapunzel
rapunzel.body: You are creative, cheerful and bursting with curiosity. You have a dozen hobbies and a sense of wonder about everything. Once you find your courage, nothing can keep you in a tower.

tiana.name: Tiana
tiana.body: You are hardworking, determined and practical. You know dreams take effort and you're willing to put it in. Don't forget to dance now and then: what you need and what you want both matter.

moana.name: Moana
moana.body: You are adventurous, strong-willed and devoted to your people. You'll cross an ocean to do what's right, and you learn from every wave that knocks you down. You know who you are.
